title: Jonathan Lawrance Clay Gravestone, B&W Snapshot, 1968
description: A black and white photograph depicting an intricate Victorian arched headstone set in a grassy cemetery. The main inscription details members of the Worth and Clay families, including Joseph Worth, his wife Ann (d. 1902), grandson Ernest Clay (d. 1905), and a lower added plaque for Jonathan Lawrance Clay (1894–1968).
